search.aide: TikTok searches in 5 languages, about 30 videos per search.

curve.titre: Track the curve of spotted videos
curve.aide: 3 readings per video (H+6, H+24, H+48): by H+48 you know if it will break out.

tiktok.aide: 1 credit = an account's last 9 videos. Active accounts every day, quiet ones every 3 days, dormant ones every week: 2,000 readings cover 3,000 accounts.

insta.aide: The Instagram account given in a tracked account's TikTok bio. 1 credit = its last ~12 Reels, at the same pace as on TikTok.

transcript.aide: What is said in the videos that stand out most (2 minutes at most). 1 credit, nothing when there is nothing to transcribe.

ai.aide: Format, structure, Snytch and BLUSH adaptations. Stops at the cap.

network.aide: Each followed app's keywords and hashtags: every 3 days for a competitor, every week otherwise. An account that names it joins its network.

ads.aide: TikTok and Meta ad libraries: an ad that runs for a long time is a format the app pays to push. Competitors every 3 days, others every week.
